The rights holder is Angela Duckworth's lab, which publishes the only authoritative copies of the 8- and 12-item Grit Scales at angeladuckworth.com/measures and states there, verbatim: "Researchers and educators are welcome to use the scales developed by Angela's lab for non-commercial purposes" and "These scales are copyrighted. They cannot be published or used for commercial purposes or wide public distribution. Journalists and book authors should not reproduce these scales or any part of them." That is a non-commercial clause AND an explicit bar on publication and wide distribution, so it fires the SKILL's rights rules twice: the TIMSS NC rule, and the 2026-09-04 DSES no-redistribution ruling under which a quotable restriction on the rights holder's own copy overrides the licence of the deposit IRW copied from. It does override one here: the response data came from a CC0 Harvard Dataverse deposit (doi:10.7910/DVN/Y75CP2) whose xlsx prints the three item stems in a 'Question' row, so under the ECR-R source-licence rule alone this table would have shipped. Shipping item text IS publishing the scale to wide public distribution, which is exactly what the clause forbids.
